items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: So I just figured I'd get a little jazz band in there somewhere on the record, so I had Jimmy, Tommy and I didn't have a piano -- Jimmy, Tommy and Steve and Bix and they played the part.

ctx.x: Yeah, they came in because they weren't doing -- the band wasn't doing so hot, they had a lot of time on their hands. So they joined the band in Indianapolis, Steve had joined it before that.

So I just figured I'd get a little jazz band in there somewhere on the record, so I had Jimmy, Tommy and I didn't have a piano -- Jimmy, Tommy and Steve and Bix and they played the part. They just played just a chorus or so and then we went back to Hoagy's singing, and geez, it worked out well.
